justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/auxiliary/TypeProxy.java (lines 194-335). `SilentConstruction` is a small nested enum with a single singleton instance, two trivial methods (`prepare` returns the input unchanged; `appender` just instantiates `Appender`), and one nested `Appender` that contains a single `apply` method implementing one bytecode sequence. The class is narrowly focused and does not show the multiple responsibilities, large method set, or decomposition gaps typical of insufficient modularization.
